messages:
maya: RFC follow-up: proposing a "seeded KV-smoke" onboarding lane. Goal: detect caching/KV regressions early with a tiny, deterministic workload plus a small live-sample delta. Key idea: publish a compact artifact fingerprint (kv_fingerprint) that runtime + rollout can consume.

vikram: sounds useful. how do artifacts flow? immediate on upload?

maya: upload -> fast-sanity run (tokenizer, shapes). if pass, schedule seeded-kv-smoke async (deterministic seeds + small live reservoir). deep-regress only after seeded-kv PASS or explicit opt-in. Enterprise customers can force deep-regress.

diego: budget? need hard caps and skip rules for minor iterates.

maya: budget: ~120k tokens across 350 sequences. Sampling: 60% seeded deterministic traces (to hit KV hot paths), 40% reservoir from anonymized recent requests. Skip cache-stress on patch uploads unless checksum changes major weights.

lina: kv_fingerprint shape? runtime needs simple compare ops.

maya: propose kv_fingerprint = [latency_ratio, kv_miss_rate, p95_ms, token-f1_smallprobe]. Keep as flat numbers, stored in model metadata. Also emit sample_tag so we can reproduce.

vikram: quant variants? big differences there.

maya: run seeded-kv on canonical FP32 plus one default quant profile. Extra quant variants get delta-check: fast-sanity + compare kv_fingerprint delta vs canonical. If delta > thresholds -> gate to manual review.

diego: thresholds? need readable defaults and tenant overrides.

maya: draft thresholds: latency_ratio < 1.5, kv_miss_rate_delta < 0.04, p95_ms < baseline_p95 * 1.6, token-f1_smallprobe >= 0.88. Make configurable per-model-family.

lina: intake schema? we should declaratively encode lanes and enforce token budgets.

maya: sketch YAML for intake: ```yaml
lanes:
  fast-sanity:
    budget_tokens: 4000
    checks: [tokenizer,sanity]
  seeded-kv-smoke:
    budget_tokens: 120000
    checks: [kv_fingerprint,seqlen-stratified,small-quality-probe]
    stratify: [1-32,33-128,129-512]
  deep-regress:
    budget_tokens: 3_000_000
    checks: [full-bench,regression-suite,quality-evals]
```

diego: nice. intake should emit a flat outcome object: {artifact_id, lane, outcome, kv_fingerprint, sample_tag}.

maya: yes keep it flat and small. Runtime will consult kv_fingerprint at rollout and can apply fallback rules.

vikram: rollout guardrails? we need canary windows.

maya: plan: initial canary 1% for 48h with kv telemetry stream. auto-rollback if p95 > baseline*2 or kv_miss_rate delta > 0.06 or error-rate increase > 0.5%. Enterprise tenants opt-in to manual gating.

lina: retention: keep traces for 14d, compact kv_fingerprint history for 2y. audit logs for compliance.

maya: owner map: I'll own fingerprint defs + thresholds. vikram owns intake schema + enforcement. diego prototypes sampler + cost sim. lina builds dashboard / retention policy.

onboard-bot: Ticket ML-ONB-4337 created: "Seeded KV-smoke lane + fingerprint" (assignee: maya).

vikram: I'll PR intake schema with a feature-flag seeded_kv_enabled so we can roll out.

maya: thanks all. will post a short note with example kv_fingerprint deltas and CLI replay command to reproduce sample_tag. Meeting next Mon 3pm to review PRs. :thumbsup:
